title: Super Power
goal: Solve Super Power: Process exponent digits while reducing intermediate powers modulo 1337, avoiding construction of the enormous exponent.
strategy: Process exponent digits while reducing intermediate powers modulo 1337, avoiding construction of the enormous exponent.
edgeCases: A zero exponent digit still shifts the preceding exponent by a factor of ten.
inputRules: base must be a positive integer
exponents must be a non-empty array of digits
exponents is limited to 12 digits in this visualizer
each exponent entry must be a single digit 0-9
